title: No snappy scene changes
text: A camera change within 1 s of a visible cut leaves a sliver shot. Don't trim speech to fix it; hold the picture on V2 instead (keep the outgoing shot to the change, or bring the incoming shot in at it). The hold must show a masked face or a wide shot, never a talking host.
